grbl_init.tooltip: Create a Grbl motion controller bound to STEP/DIR driver pins, limit switches and laser PWM pin

grbl_begin.tooltip: Start the serial port, attach the controller to it and print the welcome banner

grbl_tick.tooltip: Drive the controller once: serial line processing, planner, stepper DDA, homing and laser state

grbl_is_idle.tooltip: True when no motion is running and no line is executing
